name: dsh-client-ui-mc-skin
description: Minecraft Ore UI theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web client — the Bedrock Edition design language (hard 90° corners, #202028 canvas, #484848 surfaces, Ore green primary actions), pixel font, persistent toggles, and an optional Minecraft AE pixel font streamed on demand by the host half. · 为 DSH Web 客户端准备的 Minecraft Ore UI 主题：按基岩版新版界面语言重绘（硬直角、#202028 画布、#484848 面板、Ore 绿主操作）、像素字体、可持久化的开关，以及可选的 Minecraft AE 像素字体。
